-- Module:Exobiology
-- Renderer and query layer for Module:Data/Exobiology/Species.
local p = {}
local cache

local function esc(value)
    return mw.text.nowiki(tostring(value or ''))
end

local function loadData()
    if cache then return cache end
    local title = mw.title.new('Data/Exobiology/Species', 'Module')
    if not title then error('Module:Exobiology: invalid data title') end
    local content = title:getContent()
    if not content then error('Module:Exobiology: data page is missing') end
    local ok, data = pcall(mw.text.jsonDecode, content)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.species) ~= 'table' then
        error('Module:Exobiology: invalid species JSON')
    end
    if data.schema_version ~= 1 then
        error('Module:Exobiology: unsupported schema version ' .. tostring(data.schema_version))
    end
    cache = data
    return data
end

local function findRecord(title)
    local needle = mw.ustring.lower(tostring(title or ''))
    for _, record in ipairs(loadData().species) do
        if mw.ustring.lower(record.title) == needle then return record end
    end
    return nil
end

local function requestedRecord(frame)
    local title = frame.args.title or frame.args.name or mw.title.getCurrentTitle().text
    local record = findRecord(title)
    if not record then
        return nil, '<strong class="error">Unknown Exobiology species: ' .. esc(title) .. '</strong>'
    end
    return record, nil
end

local function number(value)
    local text = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0))
    local changed
    repeat text, changed = text:gsub('^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)', '%1,%2') until changed == 0
    return text
end

local function namedVariantCount(record)
    local count = 0
    for _, variant in ipairs(record.variants or {}) do
        if variant.variant_name ~= nil then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

local function displayValue(value)
    if type(value) == 'table' then
        local values = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(value) do table.insert(values, displayValue(item)) end
        return table.concat(values, ', ')
    end
    if type(value) == 'string' then
        value = value:gsub('(%l)(%u)', '%1 %2')
    end
    return esc(value)
end

local LABELS = {
    atmosphere = 'Atmosphere', body_type = 'Body type', min_gravity = 'Minimum gravity',
    max_gravity = 'Maximum gravity', min_temperature = 'Minimum temperature',
    max_temperature = 'Maximum temperature', min_pressure = 'Minimum pressure',
    max_pressure = 'Maximum pressure', volcanism = 'Volcanism', star = 'Star',
    bodies = 'Parent bodies', regions = 'Region model', system = 'System',
    max_orbital_period = 'Maximum orbital period', nebula = 'Nebula model', tuber = 'Region model'
}

local function ruleText(rule)
    local preferred = {'system','atmosphere','body_type','min_gravity','max_gravity','min_temperature','max_temperature','min_pressure','max_pressure','volcanism','star','bodies','regions','nebula','tuber','max_orbital_period'}
    local seen, parts = {}, {}
    for _, key in ipairs(preferred) do
        if rule[key] ~= nil then
            local value = displayValue(rule[key])
            if key == 'min_gravity' or key == 'max_gravity' then value = value .. ' g' end
            if key == 'min_temperature' or key == 'max_temperature' then value = value .. ' K' end
            table.insert(parts, "'''" .. (LABELS[key] or esc(key)) .. ":''' " .. value)
            seen[key] = true
        end
    end
    for key, value in pairs(rule) do
        if not seen[key] then table.insert(parts, "'''" .. esc(key) .. ":''' " .. displayValue(value)) end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, '<br>')
end

function p.infobox(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    local epithet = record.species_epithet or '&mdash;'
    local count = namedVariantCount(record)
    local args = {
        name = record.title,
        image = record.image,
        group1 = 'BIOLOGY',
        label1 = 'Group', row1 = record.group,
        label2 = 'Species', row2 = epithet,
        label3 = 'Availability', row3 = record.platform,
        group4 = 'SAMPLING',
        label4 = 'Vista Genomics value', row4 = number(record.base_value_credits) .. ' Cr',
        label5 = 'Sample distance', row5 = number(record.sample_distance_m) .. ' m',
        label6 = 'Named variants', row6 = tostring(count),
    }
    return frame:expandTemplate { title = 'Infobox', args = args }
end

function p.classification(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    local out = {
        "* '''Group:''' " .. esc(record.group),
        "* '''Species:''' " .. esc(record.species_epithet or 'No separate epithet'),
        "* '''Game lineage:''' " .. esc(record.platform),
        "* '''Journal species token:''' <code>" .. esc(record.journal_tokens.species) .. '</code>'
    }
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

function p.value(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    return "The recorded base Vista Genomics value is '''" .. number(record.base_value_credits) .. " credits'''. This is the base value in the structured catalogue; first-to-log bonuses are not included."
end

function p.sampling(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    return "A complete genetic sample requires three scans. Each accepted colony must be at least '''" .. number(record.sample_distance_m) .. " metres''' from the previous accepted colony."
end

function p.environment(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    local rules = record.environmental_rules or {}
    if #rules == 0 then return 'No maintained environmental prediction profile is recorded.' end
    local out = {
        '{| class="wikitable"',
        '! Profile !! Community-modelled conditions'
    }
    for index, rule in ipairs(rules) do
        table.insert(out, '|-')
        table.insert(out, '| ' .. index)
        table.insert(out, '| ' .. ruleText(rule))
    end
    table.insert(out, '|}')
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

function p.variants(frame)
    local record, problem = requestedRecord(frame)
    if not record then return problem end
    local out, count = {}, 0
    for _, variant in ipairs(record.variants or {}) do
        if variant.variant_name ~= nil then
            count = count + 1
            table.insert(out, '=== ' .. esc(variant.anchor) .. ' ===')
            table.insert(out, "'''" .. esc(variant.variant_name) .. "''' is a recorded visual variant of [[" .. esc(record.title) .. "]]. Its Codex entry ID is <code>" .. esc(variant.codex_entry_id) .. '</code>.')
        end
    end
    if count == 0 then
        return 'The current Codex catalogue does not record separately named colour variants for this organism.'
    end
    return table.concat(out, '\n\n')
end

local function publishedSet(text)
    local set = {}
    for value in mw.text.gsplit(tostring(text or ''), ';', true) do
        value = mw.text.trim(value)
        if value ~= '' then set[mw.ustring.lower(value)] = true end
    end
    return set
end

function p.directory(frame)
    local data = loadData()
    local published = publishedSet(frame.args.published)
    local groups = {}
    for _, record in ipairs(data.species) do
        groups[record.group] = groups[record.group] or {}
        table.insert(groups[record.group], record)
    end
    local groupNames = {}
    for group in pairs(groups) do table.insert(groupNames, group) end
    table.sort(groupNames)
    local out = {}
    for _, group in ipairs(groupNames) do
        table.sort(groups[group], function(a,b) return a.title < b.title end)
        table.insert(out, '=== ' .. esc(group) .. ' ===')
        table.insert(out, '{| class="wikitable sortable"')
        table.insert(out, '! Species !! Base value !! Sample distance !! Known variants')
        for _, record in ipairs(groups[group]) do
            local title = esc(record.title)
            if published[mw.ustring.lower(record.title)] then title = '[[' .. title .. ']]' end
            table.insert(out, '|-')
            table.insert(out, '| ' .. title)
            table.insert(out, '| data-sort-value="' .. record.base_value_credits .. '" | ' .. number(record.base_value_credits) .. ' Cr')
            table.insert(out, '| data-sort-value="' .. record.sample_distance_m .. '" | ' .. number(record.sample_distance_m) .. ' m')
            table.insert(out, '| ' .. namedVariantCount(record))
        end
        table.insert(out, '|}')
    end
    return table.concat(out, '\n')
end

function p.test()
    local data = loadData()
    local ids, titles, codex, named = {}, {}, 0, 0
    for _, record in ipairs(data.species) do
        if ids[record.id] then error('duplicate species id ' .. record.id) end
        if titles[record.title] then error('duplicate species title ' .. record.title) end
        ids[record.id], titles[record.title] = true, true
        local anchors = {}
        for _, variant in ipairs(record.variants or {}) do
            codex = codex + 1
            if variant.variant_name ~= nil then
                named = named + 1
                if variant.anchor ~= variant.variant_name then error('unstable anchor for ' .. variant.display_name) end
                if anchors[variant.anchor] then error('duplicate anchor ' .. variant.anchor) end
                anchors[variant.anchor] = true
            elseif variant.anchor ~= nil then
                error('uncolored record has an anchor')
            end
        end
    end
    if #data.species ~= 118 or codex ~= 816 or named ~= 788 then
        error('catalogue count mismatch')
    end
    return 'PASS: 118 species; 816 Codex records; 788 named variants; schema ' .. data.schema_version
end

return p
